content.title: Helios (NYSE:HLIO) Reports Upbeat Q3
content.summary: Motion control and electronic systems manufacturer Helios Technologies (NYSE:HLIO) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 13.3% year on year to $220.3 million. Revenue guidance for the full year exceeded analysts’ estimates, but next quarter’s guidance of $197 million was less impressive, coming in 2.1% below expectations. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.72 per share was 9.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
